sections.name: MomentViewed
sections.title: Moment viewed record
sections.what: Sends one moment_viewed record each time the moment id changes, and draws nothing.
sections.why: The code comment says it runs once per page view.
sections.watch_out: React may run the effect twice in development, which could record a view twice.

sections.name: NextReadLink
sections.title: Next read link
sections.what: Draws a Next read link to the next moment or the lab home page, and records next_read_started first when a next moment exists.
sections.why: The code comment says it records the click, then navigates.
sections.watch_out: If the next moment id is missing, the click is not recorded, though the link still works.

summary: Small helpers that send page view and click records to the analytics endpoint without affecting the page.
purpose: Records that a moment was viewed and that a fan started the next read.
why: The code comment says it never blocks or fails the page.
how: The send helper posts an event name and details to the events endpoint without waiting, with keepalive so it can finish after the page closes, and ignores any failure. MomentViewed sends one record for each moment shown. NextReadLink draws a link and records a click before moving on.
inputs: Moment id, call id, the next moment id, and the user's click.
outputs: Network requests to the events endpoint and a navigation link.
risks: Failures are hidden, so broken tracking goes unnoticed. Event names and details are not checked here.
debug: In the browser's network panel, look for requests to the events endpoint. If none appear, check that the component renders and that the id is present.
